generate_3d_grid_anchors: generate 3D grid anchors for multiple feature levels using Anchor3DRangeGenerator with custom ranges and sizes
generate_aligned_3d_anchors: generate aligned 3D anchors that match voxel grid centers using AlignedAnchor3DRangeGenerator
generate_per_class_anchors: generate per-class 3D anchors with different feature map sizes using AlignedAnchor3DRangeGeneratorPerCls
generate_single_range_anchors: generate anchors in a single range with specified feature size, rotations, and scale factor
compute_num_base_anchors: compute the total number of base anchors from rotations and sizes using num_base_anchors property
